Watch: Keep a close eye on global chip sector performance and how US tech reacts to international news, given the tight linkage.

Bottom line: Risk management in your leveraged and chip-heavy positions is critical right now.
plays: Respect the QQQ stop at 670 and QQQI stop at 52 to protect capital if the tech sell-off continues.
